responsibility: Provides shared LTO streamer utilities and global state used by both readers and writers. It owns the global lto_stats counters, the active section-name prefix for normal versus offload streaming, conversion of LTO tags to human-readable names, construction of unique object-file section names, common initialization and hook setup for tree/gimple streaming, reporting of accumulated LTO statistics, and version/gating checks that decide whether LTO output is enabled and whether a bytecode file matches the expected format version.
same_name_distinction: Provides the executable utilities and global state that operate on the LTO streaming format declared in gcc/lto-streamer.h, such as lto_stats, section-name construction, hook initialization, reporting, and version/gating checks, rather than defining the format enums, data structures, declarations, and inline helpers themselves.
